items.prompt: A huge simulation reports a tiny Monte Carlo SE. Why might its real-world decision still be poor?
items.modelAnswer: The SE measures simulation noise within a model. Check parameter/model uncertainty, assumptions, dependence, costs, target/payoff correctness, rare tails and whether any real decision/action was authorized.

criteria.text: Separates simulation precision from model validity.
Checks target, assumptions and omitted costs/tails.
Does not treat small Monte Carlo SE as guaranteed profit.
